## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by tests
- [ ] No module reaches into another module's internals or tables
- [ ] A new dependency between modules is declared in `module.json` and is intended
- [ ] A changed contract or event stays compatible, or a new version was added
- [ ] Migrations are additive and safe to run before the new code is live
- [ ] A decision worth remembering has an ADR in `docs/adr/`
